verdicts.reason: A keeps a sensible order (headline, then copy, controller, can, CTA), but the FIZZBANG logo pill at the bottom is blown up so big that it competes with the headline. The can is shrunk to a tiny afterthought, the CTA button is small and crammed under it, and there is dead space between the copy and the controller. B puts the CTA above the headline, which breaks the reading order. Its body copy is almost as large as the headline, which flattens the hierarchy and wraps the copy into short ragged lines. The logo and can are tiny and squeezed into the bottom-left corner, so the brand is nearly lost, and the bottom of the canvas is empty.
